data.name: Terrel
data.gender_notes: Terrel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Terentius or Terenzius, meaning 'terrifying' or 'terrific'. This name was borne by several early Christian saints and is commonly used in the English-speaking world. The name Terrel carries the meaning “Man, warrior, bold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Terrel usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior, bold and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Terrel, derived from the Latin origins, has a rich historical background. It carries the powerful connotation of being terrifying or terrific, which could have been appealing to early Christians who sought to embody strength and courage in their daily lives. During those times, the name Terrel signified godly fear and awe, providing an inspiration for believers to face their fears and challenges with faith and bravery.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Terrel can be associated with the Biblical characteristics of both Job and Samuel. Job, who faced countless trials and tribulations, faithfully endured his suffering and remained devoted to God. Samuel, a prophet and priest, was known for obedience and godly conduct, and his name means 'God hears', reflecting the spiritual significance of listening to and responding to the Lord's will.
